## Kona Low analysis for paper

```{r}
library(blackmarbler)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyterra)
library(lubridate)
library(tigris)
library(exactextractr)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

bearer <- Sys.getenv("NASA_BEARER")
```

### Dates 

```{r}
all_dates <- list(
  baseline = seq.Date(from = ymd("2025-05-01"), to = ymd("2025-08-03"), by = "day"),
  storm1   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-10"), to = ymd("2026-03-16"), by = "day"),
  gap      = ymd("2026-03-18"),
  storm2   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-19"), to = ymd("2026-03-24"), by = "day")
)
```
